title: Account settings
content:
Account settings for a signed-in member.

Sections:
1. Profile: display name (currently "Ines O."), email (ines@example.net), and a profile photo upload.
2. Notifications: email me about rental due dates (on), workshop announcements (off), the monthly newsletter (on).
3. Rental preferences: default pickup location (Alder Street store, Harbor kiosk); preferred units (Metric or Imperial, a choice of one).
4. Danger zone: Cancel membership (a separate button).

Buttons: Save changes, Cancel.

checklist.text: the sections grouped in fieldsets with legends
a file input for the photo
a select for the pickup location
